visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square JPG shows one connected broad cloud outline at final scale, with three main upper humps and a deliberate bottom-center opening. Its thick imperfect felt-tip edge is easy to copy before any bolt, drop, or curl appears.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I compared the full raw sheet and each adjacent saved JPG crop, including finish. The fixed cloud gains an open upper bolt, a closed lower point, two separate drops, then a curl and two dashes before marker fill. Rectangular source cells were padded to square without distortion. No temporary guides or unexplained moved or removed keeper marks were observed.

transitions.observed_addition: Two thick black sides leave the unchanged center gap and kink to the right, stopping open above the future tip. The three upper humps and lower cloud lobes remain fixed.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 2 asks for only the first angled arm of the bolt and explicitly leaves its lower ends open.

transitions.observed_addition: The open lower ends continue into a leftward notch and long downward point, closing one centered zigzag bolt. The cloud outline and both attachment points remain in place.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 3 tells the reader to complete and close the lower point from the previously open strokes.

transitions.observed_addition: One broad outlined teardrop appears to the left of the bolt and one to the right, both below the cloud with visible white gaps. The bolt tip, cloud lobes and center attachments remain fixed.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 4 asks for exactly one separate raindrop on each side of the established bolt.

transitions.observed_addition: One short black curl appears inside the left cloud lobe; exactly two black dashes sit to the left and right of the bolt tip. Both drops and the completed bolt persist.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 5 names the single curl and two separated comic dashes without changing the existing storm shapes.

transitions.observed_addition: Blue-violet marker fills the same cloud, yellow fills the fixed bolt, teal fills both outlined drops, and magenta colors the two earlier black dashes. The black curl and all prior outlines remain visible; no new structure is introduced.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction names the four observed color regions and keeps every earlier landmark.
